# The future of sustainable urban and sub-regional mobility

##### Green, fast, inaudible and safe

# ThrustPod

### Electric vertical take-off and landing with ducted fan

#### Unprecedented efficiency

#### Enhanced reliability and safety

#### Extractable motors

#### No need of infrastructures

# Aircraft

### Fixed wing with dedicated electric open propeller

#### Comfortable flight

#### Inaudible from the ground

#### Any-weather operations

#### Environment controlled payload bay

## The drone

### The most efficient solution for aerial good delivery

Max speed = 300 km/h

Max altitude = 5000 m

Max take-off mass = 30 kg

#### Typical mission

##### 5 kg payload in 24 L   (0.33 x 0.33 x 0.22 m3)

##### 200 km range (one way) or 100 km (round trip)

##### Vertical flight time = 3 min

##### 150 km/h cruise speed

[Simulate your mission](https://supair.it/demo)
